subject.title: [Feishu] Interactive Card message content parsing missing

question: What agent-visible payload contract should Feishu interactive cards use across direct inbound cards, card-action form/select callbacks, and merge_forward card sub-messages?
rationale: The direct inbound parser gap is source-proven, but exposing button, select, and form payloads changes Feishu channel message semantics and must preserve existing simple button command behavior.

options.title: Coordinate scoped Feishu fixes
options.body: Keep this issue as the broad tracker, reuse the existing interactive-card parser for direct inbound messages, and let the open callback-field and merge_forward issues own their narrower payload details.

options.title: Limit to direct inbound text
options.body: Scope this issue to `message_type: interactive` text extraction only and leave callback fields and merge_forward behavior entirely to existing linked issues.

options.title: Define typed payload first
options.body: Pause implementation until maintainers decide whether agents should receive extracted text only or fuller structured card/action envelopes.

recommendation.title: Coordinate scoped Feishu fixes
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the broad tracker, reuse the existing interactive-card parser for direct inbound messages, and let the open callback-field and merge_forward issues own their narrower payload details.

likelyOwner.reason: The open question is Feishu-plugin-specific behavior direction, and the package metadata names this handle as the community-maintained contact.
